observed_gap: The current writer serialized save operations but did not bind them to the preferences shown when a window loaded or opened its settings. A later window could overwrite another selection; a directory flush error after replacement could report a completed write as failure.
changes: Read-only exact-byte snapshot returns a SHA256 observation or an explicit missing-file observation. Invalid readable JSON remains available for explicit repair without automatic migration.
The existing atomic writer optionally checks the caller's observation under its existing writer guard and always rechecks the initial raw-byte digest after stage flush, before replacement.
The successful atomic replacement is the publication point. A later directory flush error does not cause a second write; temporary cleanup no longer addresses the old stage name after publication.
The current presenter retains its own observation, updates it only after successful save, and never adopts a foreign version on conflict.

Each settings dialog reads a separate fresh snapshot for the displayed fields. OK uses exactly that observation; Cancel leaves the presenter's preferences, notification runtime and observation unchanged.
Immediate mute remains available when persistence fails, with the existing visible session-only notice. No voice discovery, engine activation or network request is added.
preserved: All existing progress schemas and 32 canonical preference compatibility cases.
Existing save return value and callers without an observation argument.
Existing single-link/no-reparse/file-identity/read-size guards, writer owner and backup byte preservation.
Existing explicit voice selection and media suppression.
